name: resistance band reverse hyper with stability ball on flat bench
description: A reverse hyper with your torso on a stability ball and a band adding resistance. It trains glutes and hamstrings while sparing the spine.
instructions: Lie face down with your hips over a stability ball on a flat bench.
Loop a band around your feet and anchor it low in front.
Raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
